per_query.question: Which suppliers generate the most total revenue after discounts across all their products?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT s.company_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.suppliers s
JOIN public.products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id
GROUP BY s.company_name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT s.supplier_id,
       s.company_name,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.suppliers s
JOIN public.products p ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.company_name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, s.supplier_id

per_query.question: Which customer countries generate the highest total revenue after discounts?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT c.country, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.customers c
JOIN public.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT c.country,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.customers c
JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.country

per_query.question: For each shipping company, what is the average shipping delay in days and how many orders were shipped late?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT s.company_name, 
       AVG(o.shipped_date - o.required_date) AS average_delay_days, 
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date) AS late_orders_count
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.shippers s ON o.ship_via = s.shipper_id
GROUP BY s.company_name
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT s.shipper_id,
       s.company_name,
       AVG(CASE WHEN o.shipped_date > o.required_date THEN (o.shipped_date - o.required_date)::numeric END) AS avg_late_days,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date) AS late_orders,
       COUNT(*) AS shipped_orders
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.shippers s ON s.shipper_id = o.ship_via
WHERE o.shipped_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.required_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.shipper_id, s.company_name
ORDER BY avg_late_days DESC NULLS LAST, late_orders DESC, s.shipper_id

per_query.question: Which products look overstocked right now, where units_in_stock plus units_on_order is much higher than reorder_level?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT product_name, units_in_stock, units_on_order, reorder_level
FROM public.products
WHERE (units_in_stock + units_on_order) > (reorder_level * 2)
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id,
       p.product_name,
       p.units_in_stock,
       p.units_on_order,
       p.reorder_level,
       (p.units_in_stock + p.units_on_order - p.reorder_level) AS excess_units
FROM public.products p
WHERE p.reorder_level > 0
  AND (p.units_in_stock + p.units_on_order) >= (2 * p.reorder_level)
ORDER BY excess_units DESC, p.product_id

per_query.question: Among discontinued products, which categories have the highest number of products?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count
FROM public.products p
JOIN public.categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE p.discontinued = 1
GROUP BY c.category_name
ORDER BY product_count DESC
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT c.category_id,
       c.category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS discontinued_products
FROM public.categories c
JOIN public.products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE p.discontinued = 1
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
ORDER BY discontinued_products DESC, c.category_id

per_query.question: Which employees serve the largest number of distinct customers?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS distinct_customers
FROM public.employees e
JOIN public.orders o ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT e.employee_id,
       e.first_name,
       e.last_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS distinct_customers_served,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM public.employees e
JOIN public.orders o ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
ORDER BY distinct_customers_served DESC, order_count DESC, e.employee_id

per_query.question: Which customers have never placed an order?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name
FROM public.customers c
LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_id IS NULL;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.company_name,
       c.country
FROM public.customers c
LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.customer_id

per_query.question: Month by month, how many orders were created and how many were shipped after the required date?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS month, 
    COUNT(order_id) AS orders_created, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN shipped_date > required_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_shipments
FROM 
    public.orders
GROUP BY 
    month
ORDER BY 
    month;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_created,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date) AS late_orders
FROM public.orders o
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date
ORDER BY month

per_query.question: Which supplier-country and customer-country combinations appear most often in sold line items?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT s.country AS supplier_country, c.country AS customer_country, COUNT(*) AS frequency
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
JOIN public.products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN public.suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
GROUP BY s.country, c.country
ORDER BY frequency DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT s.country AS supplier_country,
       c.country AS customer_country,
       COUNT(*) AS line_item_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT od.order_id) AS order_count
FROM public.order_details od
JOIN public.products p ON p.product_id = od.product_id
JOIN public.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
JOIN public.orders o ON o.order_id = od.order_id
JOIN public.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY s.country, c.country
ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, order_count DESC, supplier_country, customer_country

per_query.question: Which products have the highest average discount across their order lines?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, AVG(od.discount) AS average_discount
FROM public.order_details od
JOIN public.products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY average_discount DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id,
       p.product_name,
       AVG(od.discount) AS avg_discount,
       COUNT(*) AS order_line_count
FROM public.products p
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY avg_discount DESC, order_line_count DESC, p.product_id

per_query.question: Which shippers handle the highest total freight value?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT s.company_name, SUM(o.freight) AS total_freight_value
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.shippers s ON o.ship_via = s.shipper_id
GROUP BY s.company_name
ORDER BY total_freight_value DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT s.shipper_id,
       s.company_name,
       SUM(o.freight) AS total_freight,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.shippers s ON s.shipper_id = o.ship_via
GROUP BY s.shipper_id, s.company_name
ORDER BY total_freight DESC, order_count DESC, s.shipper_id

per_query.question: Which territories have the highest number of assigned employees?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT t.territory_description, COUNT(et.employee_id) AS employee_count
FROM public.territories t
JOIN public.employee_territories et ON t.territory_id = et.territory_id
GROUP BY t.territory_description
ORDER BY employee_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT t.territory_id,
       t.territory_description,
       COUNT(DISTINCT et.employee_id) AS employee_count
FROM public.territories t
LEFT JOIN public.employee_territories et ON et.territory_id = t.territory_id
GROUP BY t.territory_id, t.territory_description
ORDER BY employee_count DESC, t.territory_id

per_query.question: Which regions are linked to the highest total revenue through employee territories?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT t.region_id, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.employee_territories et
JOIN public.employees e ON et.employee_id = e.employee_id
JOIN public.orders o ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
JOIN public.territories t ON et.territory_id = t.territory_id
GROUP BY t.region_id
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
WITH employee_regions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT et.employee_id, t.region_id
    FROM public.employee_territories et
    JOIN public.territories t ON t.territory_id = et.territory_id
)
SELECT r.region_id,
       r.region_description,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM employee_regions er
JOIN public.region r ON r.region_id = er.region_id
JOIN public.orders o ON o.employee_id = er.employee_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_description
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, r.region_id

per_query.question: Which customers place frequent but low-value orders?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, AVG(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS avg_order_value
FROM public.customers c
JOIN public.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 5 AND AVG(od.unit_price * od.quantity) < 100
ORDER BY order_count DESC, avg_order_value ASC
LIMIT 10;
per_query.reference_sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT o.order_id,
           o.customer_id,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS order_value
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           c.company_name,
           COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           AVG(ot.order_value) AS avg_order_value,
           SUM(ot.order_value) AS total_value
    FROM public.customers c
    JOIN order_totals ot ON ot.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
)
SELECT cs.customer_id,
       cs.company_name,
       cs.order_count,
       cs.avg_order_value,
       cs.total_value
FROM customer_stats cs
WHERE cs.order_count >= 10
  AND cs.avg_order_value < (SELECT AVG(order_value) FROM order_totals)
ORDER BY cs.order_count DESC, cs.avg_order_value ASC, cs.customer_id

per_query.question: Within each supplier, which product categories contribute most of that supplier's revenue?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT s.company_name, c.category_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue
FROM public.suppliers s
JOIN public.products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
JOIN public.categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id
GROUP BY s.company_name, c.category_name
ORDER BY s.company_name, revenue DESC
per_query.reference_sql:
WITH supplier_category_revenue AS (
    SELECT s.supplier_id,
           s.company_name AS supplier_name,
           c.category_id,
           c.category_name,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS category_revenue
    FROM public.suppliers s
    JOIN public.products p ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
    JOIN public.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.company_name, c.category_id, c.category_name
),
supplier_totals AS (
    SELECT supplier_id,
           SUM(category_revenue) AS supplier_total_revenue
    FROM supplier_category_revenue
    GROUP BY supplier_id
)
SELECT scr.supplier_id,
       scr.supplier_name,
       scr.category_id,
       scr.category_name,
       scr.category_revenue,
       (scr.category_revenue / NULLIF(st.supplier_total_revenue, 0)) AS revenue_share,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scr.supplier_id ORDER BY scr.category_revenue DESC, scr.category_id) AS revenue_rank_within_supplier
FROM supplier_category_revenue scr
JOIN supplier_totals st ON st.supplier_id = scr.supplier_id
ORDER BY scr.supplier_id, revenue_rank_within_supplier

per_query.question: Which customer cities generate the most orders and revenue?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT c.city, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.customers c
JOIN public.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT c.city,
       c.country,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.customers c
JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY c.city, c.country
ORDER BY order_count DESC, total_revenue DESC, c.country, c.city

per_query.question: Which products are most often ordered together with products from different categories?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT p1.product_name AS Product1, p2.product_name AS Product2, COUNT(*) AS TimesOrderedTogether
FROM public.order_details od1
JOIN public.order_details od2 ON od1.order_id = od2.order_id AND od1.product_id < od2.product_id
JOIN public.products p1 ON od1.product_id = p1.product_id
JOIN public.products p2 ON od2.product_id = p2.product_id
JOIN public.categories c1 ON p1.category_id = c1.category_id
JOIN public.categories c2 ON p2.category_id = c2.category_id
WHERE c1.category_id <> c2.category_id
GROUP BY Product1, Product2
ORDER BY TimesOrderedTogether DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT p1.product_id AS product_id_1,
       p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
       c1.category_name AS category_1,
       p2.product_id AS product_id_2,
       p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
       c2.category_name AS category_2,
       COUNT(DISTINCT od1.order_id) AS co_order_count
FROM public.order_details od1
JOIN public.order_details od2
  ON od1.order_id = od2.order_id
 AND od1.product_id < od2.product_id
JOIN public.products p1 ON p1.product_id = od1.product_id
JOIN public.products p2 ON p2.product_id = od2.product_id
JOIN public.categories c1 ON c1.category_id = p1.category_id
JOIN public.categories c2 ON c2.category_id = p2.category_id
WHERE p1.category_id <> p2.category_id
GROUP BY p1.product_id, p1.product_name, c1.category_name,
         p2.product_id, p2.product_name, c2.category_name
ORDER BY co_order_count DESC, product_id_1, product_id_2

per_query.question: By customer country, what are the average and maximum order values?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT c.country, AVG(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS average_order_value, MAX(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS max_order_value
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.country
per_query.reference_sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT o.order_id,
           c.country,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS order_value
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id, c.country
)
SELECT country,
       AVG(order_value) AS avg_order_value,
       MAX(order_value) AS max_order_value
FROM order_totals
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC, country

per_query.question: For each employee and month, how many orders were handled and what revenue did they produce?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, 
       DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS order_month, 
       COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders_handled, 
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue
FROM public.employees e
JOIN public.orders o ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, order_month
ORDER BY e.employee_id, order_month;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT e.employee_id,
       e.first_name,
       e.last_name,
       DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_handled,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.employees e
JOIN public.orders o ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date
ORDER BY e.employee_id, month

per_query.question: Which suppliers have products that were never sold?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT s.company_name
FROM public.suppliers s
JOIN public.products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
LEFT JOIN public.order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id
WHERE od.product_id IS NULL;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT s.supplier_id,
       s.company_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS unsold_product_count
FROM public.suppliers s
JOIN public.products p ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
LEFT JOIN public.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE od.order_id IS NULL
GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.company_name
ORDER BY unsold_product_count DESC, s.supplier_id

per_query.question: Which products produce high revenue despite low stock levels?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS revenue, p.units_in_stock
FROM public.products p
JOIN public.order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_name, p.units_in_stock
HAVING p.units_in_stock < 10
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id,
       p.product_name,
       p.units_in_stock,
       p.reorder_level,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.products p
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.units_in_stock <= COALESCE(NULLIF(p.reorder_level, 0), 5)
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.units_in_stock, p.reorder_level
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, p.product_id

per_query.question: Which customer demographic types generate the highest revenue?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT cd.customer_desc, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.customer_demographics cd
JOIN public.customer_customer_demo ccd ON cd.customer_type_id = ccd.customer_type_id
JOIN public.customers c ON ccd.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY cd.customer_desc
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT cd.customer_type_id,
       cd.customer_desc,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM public.customer_demographics cd
JOIN public.customer_customer_demo ccd ON ccd.customer_type_id = cd.customer_type_id
JOIN public.customers c ON c.customer_id = ccd.customer_id
JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY cd.customer_type_id, cd.customer_desc
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, cd.customer_type_id

per_query.question: Which employees sell the most into ship countries different from their own country?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM public.employees e
JOIN public.orders o ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id
WHERE e.country <> o.ship_country
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT e.employee_id,
       e.first_name,
       e.last_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cross_country_orders,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS cross_country_revenue
FROM public.employees e
JOIN public.orders o ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.ship_country IS NOT NULL
  AND e.country IS NOT NULL
  AND o.ship_country <> e.country
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
ORDER BY cross_country_revenue DESC, cross_country_orders DESC, e.employee_id

per_query.question: Which ship countries have the highest late-shipment rate?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT ship_country, 
       COUNT(*) AS total_shipments,
       SUM(CASE WHEN shipped_date > required_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_shipments,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN shipped_date > required_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_shipment_rate
FROM public.orders
GROUP BY ship_country
ORDER BY late_shipment_rate DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT o.ship_country,
       COUNT(*) AS shipped_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date) AS late_orders,
       (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS late_rate
FROM public.orders o
WHERE o.shipped_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.required_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.ship_country
ORDER BY late_rate DESC, shipped_orders DESC, o.ship_country

per_query.question: Which customers receive the largest average discount?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT c.company_name, AVG(od.discount) AS average_discount
FROM public.customers c
JOIN public.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY c.company_name
ORDER BY average_discount DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.company_name,
       AVG(od.discount) AS avg_discount,
       COUNT(*) AS discounted_line_count
FROM public.customers c
JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
ORDER BY avg_discount DESC, discounted_line_count DESC, c.customer_id

per_query.question: Which categories have the widest spread in product unit prices?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT c.category_name, MAX(p.unit_price) - MIN(p.unit_price) AS price_spread
FROM public.products p
JOIN public.categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_name
ORDER BY price_spread DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT c.category_id,
       c.category_name,
       MIN(p.unit_price) AS min_unit_price,
       MAX(p.unit_price) AS max_unit_price,
       (MAX(p.unit_price) - MIN(p.unit_price)) AS unit_price_spread
FROM public.categories c
JOIN public.products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
ORDER BY unit_price_spread DESC, c.category_id

per_query.question: Which suppliers dominate a category by revenue share?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT s.company_name, c.category_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue
FROM public.suppliers s
JOIN public.products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
JOIN public.categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON p.product_id = od.product_id
GROUP BY s.company_name, c.category_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
per_query.reference_sql:
WITH supplier_category_revenue AS (
    SELECT c.category_id,
           c.category_name,
           s.supplier_id,
           s.company_name AS supplier_name,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM public.categories c
    JOIN public.products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
    JOIN public.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, s.supplier_id, s.company_name
),
category_totals AS (
    SELECT category_id,
           SUM(revenue) AS category_total_revenue
    FROM supplier_category_revenue
    GROUP BY category_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT scr.category_id,
           scr.category_name,
           scr.supplier_id,
           scr.supplier_name,
           scr.revenue,
           (scr.revenue / NULLIF(ct.category_total_revenue, 0)) AS revenue_share,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scr.category_id ORDER BY scr.revenue DESC, scr.supplier_id) AS rn
    FROM supplier_category_revenue scr
    JOIN category_totals ct ON ct.category_id = scr.category_id
)
SELECT category_id,
       category_name,
       supplier_id,
       supplier_name,
       revenue,
       revenue_share
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY revenue_share DESC, category_id

per_query.question: For each product, how often is it sold with a non-zero discount?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(od.order_id) AS times_sold_with_discount
FROM public.order_details od
JOIN public.products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE od.discount > 0
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY times_sold_with_discount DESC;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id,
       p.product_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total_order_lines,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE od.discount > 0) AS discounted_order_lines,
       (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE od.discount > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS discounted_line_rate
FROM public.products p
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY discounted_line_rate DESC, discounted_order_lines DESC, p.product_id

per_query.question: Which months have the highest freight-to-revenue ratio?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) AS month, 
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS revenue, 
       SUM(o.freight) AS total_freight, 
       SUM(o.freight) / SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS freight_to_revenue_ratio
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY freight_to_revenue_ratio DESC
LIMIT 5;
per_query.reference_sql:
WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT o.order_id,
           DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
           o.freight,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date, o.freight
),
month_agg AS (
    SELECT month,
           SUM(freight) AS total_freight,
           SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM order_revenue
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month,
       total_freight,
       total_revenue,
       (total_freight / NULLIF(total_revenue, 0)) AS freight_to_revenue_ratio
FROM month_agg
ORDER BY freight_to_revenue_ratio DESC NULLS LAST, month

per_query.question: Which employees are connected to the most distinct regions via territories?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.region_id) AS distinct_regions
FROM public.employees e
JOIN public.employee_territories et ON e.employee_id = et.employee_id
JOIN public.territories t ON et.territory_id = t.territory_id
JOIN public.region r ON t.region_id = r.region_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
ORDER BY distinct_regions DESC
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT e.employee_id,
       e.first_name,
       e.last_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.region_id) AS distinct_regions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT et.territory_id) AS distinct_territories
FROM public.employees e
LEFT JOIN public.employee_territories et ON et.employee_id = e.employee_id
LEFT JOIN public.territories t ON t.territory_id = et.territory_id
LEFT JOIN public.region r ON r.region_id = t.region_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
ORDER BY distinct_regions DESC, distinct_territories DESC, e.employee_id
